def.zh-tw: 馬克士威把電與磁的定律統整成的一組方程式：電荷產生電場、變化的磁場產生電場、電流與變化的電場產生磁場。它預測了電磁波的存在。學測不需要它的數學形式。
def.en: The set of equations in which Maxwell brought together the laws of electricity and magnetism: charges produce electric fields, a changing magnetic field produces an electric field, and currents and a changing electric field produce magnetic fields. It predicted electromagnetic waves. The GSAT does not need their mathematical form.

def.zh-tw: 電場與磁場的變化互相產生、向外傳播所形成的波；不需要介質，在真空中的速率都是光速 $c\approx 3\times10^{8}\ \mathrm{m/s}$。光就是一種電磁波。
def.en: A wave made of changing electric and magnetic fields that keep producing each other as they travel outwards. It needs no medium, and in a vacuum every electromagnetic wave travels at the speed of light $c\approx 3\times10^{8}\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Light is one kind of electromagnetic wave.

def.zh-tw: 把電磁波依頻率（或波長）排列的整體，由頻率低到高依序是無線電波、微波、紅外線、可見光、紫外線、X射線、γ射線。
def.en: All electromagnetic waves arranged by frequency (or wavelength). From low to high frequency: radio waves, microwaves, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-rays and gamma rays.
